correctness.rationale: Strict convexity of trace((L+P0)^(-1)) under the injective edge-weight map proves unrestricted Kirchhoff-index uniqueness. Concavity of lambda2 and automorphism averaging justify a symmetric spectral-gap optimum; the argument separately proves support of every unrestricted spectral optimum. The exact three-eigenspace Laplacian spectrum gives K=1/a+4(m-1)/(a+b) and lambda2=m min(2a,a+b). Exact scalar derivatives yield c_R=4m/(4m-3), c_M=m/(m-1), uniqueness/support, compatibility and asymptotic scaling. The embedded standard-library verifier reconstructs matrices independently and passed 4699 rational checks; checks are evidence, not a universal proof.

value.rationale: Resistance-optimal and gap-optimal design are both motivated on the same fully connected two-community diffusion network; this theorem proves an exact interval in which their mandatory edge-support decisions conflict. It supplies globally correct weights for one objective and support/values for the other, the exact disagreement width and two distinct critical-price coordinates 3/4 and 1. This provides a structural decision benchmark not equivalent to a routine single-budget normalization or arbitrary finite graph table.
